import json
from unittest.mock import patch

from Orange.data import Table
from Orange.widgets.data import owcolor
from Orange.widgets.tests import base as wbase

EXAMPLE = {"categorical": {"foo": {"renamed_values": {}},
                           "bar": {"renamed_values": {}}},
           "numeric": {}}
FNAME = "/tmp/r2e_owcolor_defs.colors"


def texts(mock):
    # all call arguments except the parent widget, joined into one string
    return [" | ".join(str(a) for a in list(c[0][1:]) + list(c[1].values()))
            for c in mock.call_args_list]


class TestUnusedVarDefs(wbase.WidgetTest):
    def setUp(self):
        self.widget = self.create_widget(owcolor.OWColor)

    def _parse(self, js):
        with patch.object(owcolor.QMessageBox, "warning") as warn, \
                patch.object(owcolor.QMessageBox, "critical") as crit:
            self.widget._parse_var_defs(js)
        return texts(warn), texts(crit)

    def _load(self, js):
        with open(FNAME, "w") as f:
            json.dump(js, f)
        with patch.object(owcolor.QFileDialog, "getOpenFileName",
                          return_value=(FNAME, "*.colors")), \
                patch.object(owcolor.QMessageBox, "warning") as warn, \
                patch.object(owcolor.QMessageBox, "critical") as crit:
            self.widget.load()
        return texts(warn), texts(crit)

    def test_r2eprobe_1_parse_example_no_data(self):
        warns, crits = self._parse(EXAMPLE)
        print("warning calls:", warns, "| critical calls:", crits)
        self.assertEqual(crits, [])
        self.assertTrue(any("foo" in t and "bar" in t for t in warns), warns)

    def test_r2eprobe_2_load_example_iris(self):
        self.send_signal(self.widget.Inputs.data, Table("iris"))
        warns, crits = self._load(EXAMPLE)
        print("warning calls:", warns, "| critical calls:", crits)
        self.assertEqual(crits, [])
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.get_output(self.widget.Outputs.data))
        self.assertTrue(any("foo" in t and "bar" in t for t in warns), warns)

    def test_r2eprobe_3_load_mixed_keeps_used_defs(self):
        self.send_signal(self.widget.Inputs.data, Table("iris"))
        js = {"categorical": {"iris": {"rename": "species"},
                              "foo": {"renamed_values": {}}},
              "numeric": {"bar": {"colors": "linear_viridis"}}}
        warns, crits = self._load(js)
        print("mixed file (informational) warning calls:", warns,
              "| critical calls:", crits)
        self.assertEqual(crits, [])
        out = self.get_output(self.widget.Outputs.data)
        self.assertEqual(out.domain.class_var.name, "species")
PY
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=minimal xvfb-run --auto-servernum python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q -rA -k r2eprobe /tmp/test_r2e_owcolor_unused.py
